sentences.bookAnswer: Regular exercise can increase one's self-confidence
sentences.alternateAnswer: Frequently exercising can increase one's confidence

sentences.chinese: 教学质量对学生成绩有很大的影响
sentences.bookAnswer: The quality of teaching can make huge difference to students' academic performance
sentences.alternateAnswer: Academic achievement is heavily dependent on the quality of teaching

sentences.chinese: 家长和老师应该努力去减少小孩子看电视的时间
sentences.bookAnswer: Parents and teachers should make an effort to limit children’s screen time
sentences.alternateAnswer: Parents and teachers should make efforts to reduce the screen time of children

sentences.chinese: 经济的下滑（economic slowdown）导致失业率的上升
sentences.bookAnswer: The economic slowdown has led to a climbing unemployment rate.
sentences.alternateAnswer: The economic slowdown has led to an increase in the unemployment rate
sentences.remark: increase 本身有名词词性

sentences.chinese: 经济的发展需要年轻的劳动者
sentences.bookAnswer: A country's economic development relies on a supply of young workers
sentences.alternateAnswer: Economic development requires young laborers
sentences.remark: labors 和 laborers 的区别：前者侧重劳动的行为或者劳动力的总称，后者专指从事劳动的人

sentences.chinese: 工作量大的人没有时间去休息
sentences.bookAnswer: People with a heavy workload do not have adequate time to rest
sentences.alternateAnswer: People with heavy workloads often don't have time to rest
sentences.remark: adequate adj. 足够的，合格的。反义词 inadequate

sentences.chinese: 在中国很多学生都要上晚自习
sentences.bookAnswer: A large number of students in China have to do self-study at night
sentences.alternateAnswer: Many students in China have to attend evening self-study sessions
sentences.remark: self-study 自习

sentences.chinese: 文化遗产（heritage sites）因为城市发展而受到威胁
sentences.bookAnswer: The development of cities has posed a threat to heritage sites
sentences.alternateAnswer: Cultural heritage sites are threatened by urban development
sentences.remark: pose a threat 构成威胁

sentences.chinese: 我们不能忽视面对面的交流
sentences.bookAnswer: We should not ignore face-to-face communication
sentences.alternateAnswer: We cannot ignore face-to-face communication
sentences.remark: communication 作为交流、沟通的时候是不可数的

sentences.chinese: 有些公共服务很难做到收支平衡
sentences.bookAnswer: Some public services have problems in breaking even
sentences.alternateAnswer: Some public services are challenging to achieve a balance between revenue and expenses/Some public services find it challenging to break even
sentences.remark: break even 收支平衡

sentences.chinese: 我们需要考虑社会和经济环境
sentences.bookAnswer: We have to consider the social and economic context
sentences.alternateAnswer: We need to consider the social and economic environment

sentences.chinese: 密度种植对生物多样性造成了威胁
sentences.bookAnswer: Intensive farming can pose a threat to bio-diversity
sentences.alternateAnswer: Intensive cultivation poses a threat to biodiversity

sentences.chinese: 平等接受教育可以帮助解决学生学习成绩不好的问题
sentences.bookAnswer: Equal access to education can help tackle educational underachievement
sentences.alternateAnswer: Equal access to education can help tackle the issue of students' academic underachievement
sentences.remark: 注意这里的 help 后面的 to 是可以省略的，类似的：make/let/hear/feel/watch 等。underachievement n. 低成就；学习成绩不良

sentences.chinese: 接触不同的文化可以促进创新
sentences.bookAnswer: Exposure to different cultures can encourage creativity
sentences.alternateAnswer: Exposure to different cultures can promote innovation
sentences.remark: 注意 culture 这个词多数情况下是不可数的，表示不同地方、特定文化的时候才可数

sentences.chinese: 政府应该重视社会福利（welfare services），尤其是医疗服务
sentences.bookAnswer: The government should give priority to welfare services especially healthcare
sentences.alternateAnswer: The government should prioritize welfare services, especially healthcare

sentences.chinese: 教育或许决定了人的工作前景
sentences.bookAnswer: Education may hold the key to one's job prospects
sentences.alternateAnswer: Education might shape one's career prospects
sentences.remark: hold the key 掌控，支配。prospects 成功的机会；前景，前途

sentences.chinese: 使用化石燃料会对环境造成破坏
sentences.bookAnswer: The use of fossil fuels can cause damage to the environment
sentences.alternateAnswer: Using fossil fuels can cause environmental damage
sentences.remark: fuel 的可数和不可数的问题，表示一般的燃料的概念时不可数，不同种类时可数，例如这里 fossil fuels 表示的可能是煤、天然气、石油等...

sentences.chinese: 建造住宅楼有助于解决城市的拥挤问题
sentences.bookAnswer: Building apartment blocks helps (to) solve overcrowding in cities
sentences.alternateAnswer: Constructing residential buildings helps (to) alleviate urban congestion
sentences.remark: alleviate v. 减轻；缓和；缓解

sentences.chinese: 贫穷的人可以通过努力工作来提高其社会地位
sentences.bookAnswer: People from disadvantaged backgrounds can improve their social status by working hard.
sentences.alternateAnswer: The impoverished can improve their social status through/via hard work

sentences.chinese: 因为全球化，人们需要和来自全球不同背景的人一起工作
sentences.bookAnswer: Because of globalization, people need to work with those from diverse backgrounds
sentences.alternateAnswer: Due to globalization, people need to work with individuals from diverse backgrounds around the world
sentences.remark: ChatGPT 给的另一个表达：Due to globalization, those from diverse backgrounds around the world need to work together

sentences.chinese: 我们需要采取措施去解决一些棘手的问题
sentences.bookAnswer: We need to take action to solve some thorny problems
sentences.alternateAnswer: We need to take measures to address some challenging issues
sentences.remark: thorny adj. 棘手的，麻烦的；多刺的，带刺的。thorn n. 刺，荆棘

sentences.chinese: 媒体通过夸大受害者的伤痛去吸引观众
sentences.bookAnswer: The media attracts public attention by sensationalizing victims' suffering
sentences.alternateAnswer: The media attracts viewers by exaggerating the pain of victims

sentences.category: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语
sentences.chinese: 基因工程能让人们培养新品种农作物
sentences.bookAnswer: Genetic engineering allows people to nurture crop varieties
sentences.alternateAnswer: Genetic engineering allows people to cultivate new varieties of crops
sentences.remark: nurture v./n. 培养，促进，怀、抱有/教育，培育

sentences.category: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语

sentences.bookAnswer: Companies should provide working mothers with maternity leave and other forms of support
sentences.alternateAnswer: The company should provide maternity leave and other assistance for female employees with children
sentences.remark: maternity leave 产假

sentences.category: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语
sentences.chinese: 不健康的生活方式让人们处于生病的危险制之中
sentences.bookAnswer: An unhealthy lifestyle may put people at risk of illness
sentences.alternateAnswer: The unhealthy lifestyle puts people at risk of illness

sentences.category: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语
sentences.chinese: 奖学金可以鼓励更多的学生去学习研究生课程
sentences.bookAnswer: Government grants could encourage more students to take postgraduate courses
sentences.alternateAnswer: Scholarships can encourage more students to pursue graduate-level/postgraduate studies

sentences.category: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语

sentences.bookAnswer: Community service provides offenders with opportunities to acquire transferable skills
sentences.alternateAnswer: The community redevelopment provides opportunities for criminals to acquire vocational skills

sentences.category: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语
sentences.chinese: 法律应该将醉驾定为刑事犯罪
sentences.bookAnswer: Legislation should make drink driving a criminal offense/offence
sentences.alternateAnswer: Laws should classify drunk driving as a criminal offense/offence
sentences.remark: Legislation/Laws 的区别，Legislation 一般只整个法律体系，Law 一般指具体的法律。drink/drunk driving 都是合理的表达前者在英国常用后者在美国。criminal offense 刑事犯罪，civil offense/wrong 民事犯罪

sentences.category: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语
sentences.chinese: 乡村地区给人们提供远离现代生活的压力和噪声的机会
sentences.bookAnswer: Rural areas provide people with opportunities to escape pressure and noises of modern life
sentences.alternateAnswer: Rural areas provide people with opportunities to escape pressure and noise of modern life —— 和书的答案只是复数用的词是 pressure
sentences.remark: pressure 和 noise 都是可数又不可数，ChatGPT 表示都可以用

sentences.category: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语
sentences.chinese: 人口老龄化促使国家提高法定退休年龄（statutory retirement age）
sentences.bookAnswer: The ageing population has prompted countries to raise statutory retirement age
sentences.alternateAnswer: The aging population is prompting the country to raise statutory retirement age
sentences.remark: ageing 和 aging 这两种拼写都可以

sentences.category: 主语 + 及物动词 + 间接宾语 + 直接宾语
sentences.chinese: 政府应该给一些城市提供资金去保护历史建筑（historic buildings）
sentences.bookAnswer: Governments should offer some cities funds to preserve historic buildings
sentences.alternateAnswer: The government should provide funds to some cities to preserve historic buildings

sentences.chinese: 学校应该允许老师强制捣蛋的小孩离开教室
sentences.bookAnswer: Teachers should be permitted to use force to remove the disruptive children from the classroom
sentences.alternateAnswer: The troublesome children should be allowed to remove from the classroom by the teachers

sentences.chinese: 农村的失业问题在某种程度上可以通过城乡转移（rural-to-urban shift）来解决
sentences.bookAnswer: Unemployment in rural areas can be addressed partially by the rural-to-urban shift
sentences.alternateAnswer: The issue of unemployment in rural areas can be addressed to some extent through rural-to-urban shift
sentences.remark: in/of rural areas 这里的区别 in 强调位置 of 强调属性、特点。address/solve 前者强调对问题处理的过程比一定解决问题，后者强调处理问题的方案彻底解决问题。to some extent/partially/partly 可以一定程度互换

sentences.chinese: 高层建筑有时候被认为是影响市容的东西（eyesore）
sentences.bookAnswer: High-rise buildings are sometimes regarded as eyesores of the city
sentences.alternateAnswer: High-rise buildings are sometimes considered as eyesores that impact the cityscape
sentences.remark: eyesore n. （公共场所的）不顺眼的东西，难看的东西。consider/regard as 前者强调主观、个人的看法，后者强调正式、客观的看法

sentences.chinese: 太空科技的投资应该获得政府的支持
sentences.bookAnswer: The investment in space technology should be supported by the government
sentences.alternateAnswer: Space technology investments should be supported by the government
sentences.remark: 对于可数名词要么是复数要么加冠词。investment in 表示对某领域的投资属于习惯用法所以尽量用这个介词

sentences.chinese: 历史文物因为其历史重要性而被保存
sentences.bookAnswer: Historic relics should be preserved for their historic significance
sentences.alternateAnswer: Historical artifacts are preserved due to their historical significance
sentences.remark: 历史文物：historic relics/artifacts。历史重要性：historic significance。historic 强调历史重要性，historical 表示历史有关的

sentences.chinese: 学校活动的设置要让孩子体会到成就感，提升他们的幸福感
sentences.bookAnswer: Sports or other school activities can be designed to give children a sense of accomplishment and to promote their well-being
sentences.alternateAnswer: A sense of achievement and an enhanced sense of happiness should be experienced by children through the arrangement of school activities
sentences.remark: school activities/design/give/a sense of accomplishment/promote/well-bing

sentences.chinese: 一些员工被鼓励去打破陈规
sentences.bookAnswer: Some employees are encouraged to break the mould
sentences.alternateAnswer: Some employees are encouraged to break conventions
sentences.remark: mould/mold 霉菌、模子、性格的意思；break the mould/mold 打破常规

sentences.chinese: 因为堵车，上下班的时间变得更长了
sentences.bookAnswer: Commuting time has been prolonged because of traffic congestion
sentences.alternateAnswer: Due to traffic congestion, the commuting time has been extended
sentences.remark: commute v./n. 上下班往返，通勤；变换，改变（支付方式）；减刑/通勤。commuting time 通勤时间。prolong v. 延长，拖延。have/has been done 现在完成时的被动

sentences.chinese: 电脑技能可以运用到学习和工作中
sentences.bookAnswer: Computer skills can be applied in their studies as well as their working lives
sentences.alternateAnswer: Computer skills can be applied to learning and work
sentences.remark: computer skills 电脑技能。apply 运用，介词用 in。as well (as) = in addition (to) 除什么之外，也，和

sentences.chinese: 大部分的环境破坏都可以归咎于人类的活动
sentences.bookAnswer: Most of environmental degradation is attributed to human activities.
sentences.alternateAnswer: Most environmental damage can be attributed to human activities.
sentences.remark: degradation n. 玷污，损害，危害；落魄，降低身份，丢脸。environmental degradation 环境恶化。attribute sth. to sb./sth. 动词短语：把...归因于；认为...由...生产；认为...是...所为

sentences.chinese: 许多孩子每天接触暴力内容
sentences.bookAnswer: Many children are exposed to violent content every day
sentences.alternateAnswer: 第一次给的和书上的一模一样，强行换一句之后：Many children are exposed to violent content on a daily basis
sentences.remark: expose sb. to sth. 使...遭受（有害或不愉快的遭受）；使...暴露于（险境）。另外要注意 everyday adj. 日常的，普通的和 every day 不一样

sentences.chinese: 家庭环境被认为是小孩成长最重要的影响因素
sentences.bookAnswer: The family environment is widely thought/believed to be the most important influence on children's development
sentences.alternateAnswer: The family environment is considered the most crucial influencing factor in child's upbringing
sentences.remark: upbringing n. 抚养，养育；教育，教养

sentences.chinese: 随着越来越多的年轻人参加志愿者工作，社区的凝聚力（cohesion）会加强
sentences.bookAnswer: With an increasing number of young people participating in volunteer work, community cohesion will be enhanced
sentences.alternateAnswer: As more and more young people engage in volunteer work, the cohesion of the community will be strengthened
sentences.remark: 这里书上的例子前面半句算是个介词短语作状语，ChatGPT 给的前面是个状语从句，是个完整的句子

sentences.chinese: 移民有时候被认为是对社会团结的一个威胁
sentences.bookAnswer: Immigrants are sometimes recognized as a threat to social cohesion
sentences.alternateAnswer: Immigration is sometimes considered as a thread to social cohesion
sentences.remark: 社会团结：social cohesion

sentences.chinese: 没有受过高等教育的年轻人只能找到低技术含量的工作
sentences.bookAnswer: Young people without tertiary education qualifications normally end up working in low-skilled jobs
sentences.alternateAnswer: Young people without higher education are limited to jobs with low skill requirements
sentences.remark:
tertiary adj. 第三的，第三级的；高等教育的，第三产业的 ~ education 高等教育，~ industry 第三产业。
 在英语中，通常使用 "to" 介词来连接不及物动词。这是因为 "to" 表示方向、目标、目的等概念，而不及物动词通常需要一个目标或方向。

sentences.chinese: 一些人不支持转基因食品
sentences.bookAnswer: Some people disapprove of genetically modified food
sentences.alternateAnswer: Some people do not support genetically modified (GM) foods -> 这个句子不是不及物动词结构
sentences.remark: 转基因：GM=genetically modified。do not 和 don't 一般前者更适合书面更正式，意思是一样的

sentences.chinese: 旅游景点竭力满足游客的需要和品味
sentences.bookAnswer: Tourist spots endeavor to cater for tourists' needs and tastes
sentences.alternateAnswer: Tourist attractions strive to meet the needs and tastes of visitors
sentences.remark:
主语+不及物动词+to do不定式
景点：tourist spots/attractions

sentences.chinese: 在竞争激烈的社会，有工作的成年人往往关注职业发展
sentences.bookAnswer: In a highly competitive society, working adults usually focus on career advancement
sentences.alternateAnswer: In a competitive society, working adults often focus on career development
sentences.remark: advancement n. 发展，提高，改善

sentences.chinese: 审美观是因为文化而异的
sentences.bookAnswer: Perception of beauty differs from culture to culture
sentences.alternateAnswer: Aesthetic perspectives vary with cultural differences
sentences.remark:
perception n. 认识，观念，看法；感知，感觉；感知能力，认识能力，洞察力 
from culture to culture 
 perspective n. （思考问题的）角度，观点，想法 
 get/keep sth in perspective 合理地评价；正确地看待

sentences.chinese: 因为费用的下降，航空业最近几十年发展的很快
sentences.bookAnswer: Because of low-cost carries, the aviation industry has developed at an astounding pace over the past decades
sentences.alternateAnswer: Due to the decrease in costs, the aviation industry has developed rapidly in recent decades
sentences.remark:
astounding adj. 令人震惊的；使人惊骇的。
pace n. （移动的）步速；（发生的）速度；节奏

sentences.chinese: 动物实验有时候检验不出药物的副作用
sentences.bookAnswer: Animal experiments sometimes fail to detect the undesirable side effects of drugs
sentences.alternateAnswer: 给出的句子和书上的一样，换了一种表达之后是：At times. The use of animal experiments does not reveal the adverse effects of medications
sentences.remark: adverse adj. 不离的；负面的；有害的

sentences.chinese: 非法捕杀导致某些动物的灭亡
sentences.bookAnswer: Some animals have died out because of illegal hunting
sentences.alternateAnswer: Illegal hunting results in the extinction of certain animals
sentences.remark: die out 逐渐消失；灭绝

sentences.chinese: 电脑对人类交流技能的影响随着年龄而变化
sentences.bookAnswer: The impact of computers on communication skills varies across ages
sentences.alternateAnswer: The impact of computers on human communication skills varies with age
sentences.remark: across 是介词，表示横跨某个区域表面；cross 是个动词

sentences.chinese: 很多女孩都不愿意再男人居多的行业里（male-dominated world）找工作
sentences.bookAnswer: Many girls are not willing to seek employment in a male-dominated world
sentences.alternateAnswer: Many girls are unwilling to seek employment in male-dominated industries

sentences.chinese: 学校的主要功能是给下一代传授知识（impart knowledge）
sentences.bookAnswer: The main function of schools is to impart knowledge to the next generation
sentences.alternateAnswer: The primary function of schools is to impart knowledge to the next generation
sentences.remark:
school 是可数的所以要加复数或者冠词
ChatGPT 说 to the next generation 可以改成 for ~

sentences.chinese: 艺术不属于学校的主科
sentences.bookAnswer: The arts are not among core subject areas at school
sentences.alternateAnswer: Art is not considered/regarded as a core subject in schools

sentences.chinese: 因为经济前景（economic outlook）不够明朗，很多公司不太可能招聘新的职员
sentences.bookAnswer: Because of the uncertainty about he economic outlook, many companies are unlikely to recruit new employees
sentences.alternateAnswer: Due to the unclear economic outlook, many companies are less likely to hire new employees

sentences.chinese: 空运可能产生很多温室气体
sentences.bookAnswer: Air freight is likely to create enormous greenhouse gases
sentences.alternateAnswer: Air transport may generate a significant amount of greenhouse gases
sentences.remark: freight n.货物、货运；运费

sentences.chinese: 孩子很可能有行为问题
sentences.bookAnswer: Some children are likely to have behavioral/behavioural problems
sentences.alternateAnswer: The child is likely to have behavioral issues
sentences.remark: behavioral/behavioural 写法是等价的

sentences.chinese: 人口大量扩张是大量垃圾产生的原因
sentences.bookAnswer: The rapid population expansion is the main reason for the huge accumulation of waste
sentences.alternateAnswer: The substantial expansion of population is a cause of the significant increase in waste production
sentences.remark: substantial adj. 大的；可观的；价值巨大的；重大的；基本上；大体上

sentences.chinese: 严厉的惩罚是减少犯罪率的有效手段
sentences.bookAnswer: Imposing stiff punishment is an effective method to reduce crime
sentences.alternateAnswer: Harsh punishment is an effective means of reducing crime rates
sentences.remark: impose v. 推行；强制实施；把（尤指信仰或者生活方式）强加于；勉强；打扰；麻烦

sentences.chinese: 我们的环境还是很糟糕
sentences.bookAnswer: Our environment is still in a dire state
sentences.alternateAnswer: Our environment is still quite poor
sentences.remark: dire adj. 严重的；危急的；极端的；很坏的

sentences.chinese: 因为失业率高涨，大学生迫于压力而努力学习
sentences.bookAnswer: Undergraduates feel under increasing pressure to study hard, because of the soaring unemployment rate
sentences.alternateAnswer: Due to the soaring unemployment rate, college students strive to study under pressure
sentences.remark:
feel 也是系动词
soaring adj. 高耸的；展翅翱翔的
strive vi. （尤指长期或不畏艰难地）努力，奋斗，力争

sentences.chinese: 种族歧视依然非常严重
